summary: Executed Iter70 targeted backend+frontend regression on public URL. 8 backend tests run for optional artist URL, track featuring, quota atomicity, internal legacy cover, and takedown workflow; 7 passed and 1 failed reproducibly. Frontend smoke + label upload flow verified quota visibility and optional artist web URL step progression.

critical.issue: Owner upload for imported_legacy release returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error (reproduced twice) instead of success/structured error.

action_items: Fix internal legacy cover upload handler returning HTTP 500 for valid owner upload (imported_legacy=true).
Add/restore backend exception traceback logging for this endpoint so root cause is visible in supervisor logs.
After fix, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter70_release_quota_cover_takedown.py including internal-cover and permission assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: Submission quota behavior is functionally solid in tested paths: exactly 7/day, 8th returns 429+Retry-After, duplicate same-release concurrency yields single commit, and rejected same-day resubmit reuses counted slot.
Track-level featured_artists persistence/edit and cross-label artist_id rejection worked as expected for tested single/EP payloads.
Takedown completion path correctly changes linked live release to taken_down and remains idempotent on repeated done calls.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (core scoped checks passed; no new UI blocker reproduced with verified fixture)

seed_data_creation: Used isolated Iter66 UI fixture account via /app/tests/iter66_ui_fixture.py seed for frontend auth-gated checks, then cleaned with /app/tests/iter66_ui_fixture.py cleanup. Backend tests created isolated label/release/ticket fixtures and cleaned owned records (including label_daily_submissions/release_operation_locks/release_internal_covers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Internal-cover upload is the only failing backend case in this run and is reproducible. Other new features in scope passed on targeted regression. If debugging internal-cover, start from /api/releases/{id}/internal-cover with imported_legacy=true owner release and inspect route-level unhandled exception path.
rca of the issue: Repro: create verified label + imported_legacy release owned by that label -> POST multipart JPEG to /api/releases/{id}/internal-cover with owner bearer token. Actual: HTTP 500 plain 'Internal Server Error'. Expected: 200 with internal_cover_url/display_cover_url or controlled 4xx/5xx JSON detail. Observed supervisor logs record the 500 request but did not expose a clear traceback for this failure window, indicating missing/insufficient exception surfacing in this path.
